calculate_3d_iou: calculate the 3D IoU between two sets of 3D bounding boxes using boxes_iou3d
calculate_bev_overlap: calculate the BEV overlap area between two sets of 3D bounding boxes using boxes_overlap_bev
run_3d_nms: run 3D non-maximum suppression on bounding boxes with scores using nms3d
run_normal_3d_nms: run normal 3D NMS with yaw angle set to zero using nms3d_normal
calculate_bev_iou: calculate the BEV IoU between two sets of rotated 2D boxes using boxes_iou_bev
